method: manual static instruction review; not LLM evaluation

cases.reviewed_rule: A better measured schedule updates current-task experience and the next action; no instruction edit or global interval rule.
Repeated support does not promote local experience into fixed skills; preserve its task scope.
Filter incompatible evidence before matching background or considering recency.
Prefer the latest authoritative experience update available at the current state; retain the opposite counterexample.
No hindsight from future updates and no invented date; copying text does not refresh evidence.
Restore a compatible search basis, not a different skill version or old ledger; keep the experiment-bound hashes.
External RSI must wait for machine evidence that all original targets and required work completed; no human question or missing-experiment execution.
Completion may include accounted failed slots under the original protocol; do not resample. A stopped unfinished target is different.
External RSI may review one principal supported problem and create a new version; Guidance Agent still cannot edit skills.
Record no revision; the one-to-three module range is a bound on a supported revision, not a quota.
Actual process improvement can support future adoption without changing molecular best or claiming geometry gain; static format checks alone do not prove behavior.

Methods and abstract reasoning can be generalized. Concrete allocation experiences stay task-local; a new-task empirical prior is separate, unmeasured and subordinate to receiving-target counterevidence.
Exact experience provenance stays in the update log; runtime output can still cite its current-task evidence. The log and external RSI body are excluded from role loading.
Actual create-only renderer rejects existing destination, including an empty directory; read-only --check reports drift without repair.
Old hardcoded loader/per-version mutation gate is an integration conflict, not evidence new skills are activated.
Changing the external RSI skill also requires a new version and the completed-experiment gate; it is not an unbounded self-calling loop.

resolution_priority: Latest direct R1-R6 answers supersede earlier within-experiment skill mutation and old checkpoint skill restoration. Other confirmed scientific/search constraints remain.
